raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the Export Administration Regulations. Exporters of sporting and hunting firearms (HTS 9302/9303) should re-verify ECCN classification, license exception eligibility, and end-use/end-user screening, while aligning US HTS lines with Section 301 tariff exposure and BIS Entity List checks. Reassess prior license applications and recordkeeping obligations under the revised controls before shipment.
raw.content_zh: 美国工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了《出口管理条例》下民用枪支弹药的许可与分类处理。出口运动及狩猎类枪支（HS 9302/9303）的企业应重新核实ECCN分类、许可例外资格及最终用途/最终用户筛查，同时将美国HTS税号与301关税风险及BIS实体清单核查对齐。发货前应重新评估既有许可申请及修订后管制下的记录保存义务。

checklist.desc: Confirm whether civilian firearms/ammunition now fall under revised EAR controls and whether a license exception applies; document classification rationale.
Screen consignees and end users against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and SDN lists; retain end-use statements.
Map 10-digit HTS lines for firearms/parts against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up.
Reassess pending or prior BIS license applications and recordkeeping obligations under the rescinded rule; update internal export compliance procedures.
Ensure invoices, EEI/AES filings, and destination statements reflect the revised classification and any license exception cited.
